name: NTK — Near The Keyboard
note: build.mjs reads this file. Change a colour here, then run node build.mjs. Every object is a block in 2:1 pixel isometric: a top face, a lit front face (lower left), a shaded right face (lower right). No outlines.

white.use: top faces of keys and small blocks

top.use: top faces of large blocks: the keyboard body, cards

lit.use: lit side faces (the front, lower left in isometric)

shade.use: shaded side faces (the right, lower right in isometric)

drop.use: the soft blocky shadow on the desk (paper)

ink.use: the wordmark, text, legends (12:1 on paper, 14:1 on white)

slate.use: the one dark block (the spacebar): top face

orange.use: accent blocks: the Enter/Sign key, the light, a verified stamp; icon backgrounds

orangeLit.use: orange block: lit side; drops on orange

drop.use: the soft blocky shadow on space

top.use: top faces of large blocks: the keyboard body, cards

lit.use: lit side faces of large blocks (lighter than the top)

shade.use: shaded side faces of large blocks

key.use: top faces of keys and small blocks

offWhite.use: the wordmark, text, legends (16:1 on space, 11.6:1 on a key)

slate.use: the one dark block (the spacebar): top face

keyboard.note: Colours for the Android keyboard themes (TODO 3.7). Each key is a block: face, a lit edge below it, a shaded edge at its right, no outline. A press darkens the face and both edges by one step. The Sign key is an orange block; its legend is #1A1A1A (5.3:1 on orange; #2B2B2B gives only 4.3:1, white 3.3:1).
